text:
Samira (Partnerships): quick heads-up 1 LatticeAI wants to onboard their Orchid-XL weights to our marketplace. they asked for an accelerated path for the HW bundle + SI-managed install.
Owen (Legal): what licensing model are they proposing? need to confirm redistribution, attribution, and export controls early.
Samira (Partnerships): they sent a draft that allows commercial redistribution but forbids sub-licensing. also wants a short provenance badge on the listing.
Kai (Eng): packaging note: they will provide zstd-compressed weights + a separate metadata.json with checksums. we need to confirm our verification and install hooks.
Priya (PM): timeline: target listing publish 2025-07-11. Marketplace SKU must include supported deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), default resource profiles, and an L2 support map. can we hit that?
Liam (HW Partner): Lattice (HW) can supply validated images for our Nuvia-compatible board. we need to sign off on power/thermals. will deliver test images by 2025-06-30.
Helga (SI - Brightline): Brightline can offer managed-install + onboarding workshops. proposed commercial terms: Brightline 55%, Redwood 30%, Lattice 15% (split on net revenue).
Owen (Legal): 55/30/15 is unusual but workable. add indemnity limits and explicit audit rights for model provenance. no automatic sublicensing.
Priya (PM): Ops question: who triages customer tickets? propose Brightline L1, Redwood L2, Lattice L3. Helga, can Brightline commit to 24h initial response?
Helga (SI - Brightline): yes, 24h for L1. we'll provide a runbook. can we get a short technical onboarding doc from Kai?
Kai (Eng): I'll create `deploy/runbook-orchidxl.md` with steps and a sample `runit` service example. ETA Fri. also will add a small perf table (p95 tail latencies) for common configs.
Samira (Partnerships): comms: Lattice requests 72h notice before any joint announcement and wants to co-author the blog. proposed embargo lift 2025-07-10 08:00 PT.
Liam (HW Partner): include a hardware compatibility note: 'validated on Nuvia board rev B2'. don't list other boards without testing.
Owen (Legal): also require a data-deletion clause for private deployments and a KMS integration guarantee for customer-managed keys.
Priya (PM): action items: Samira 1 get signed redistribution addendum by Wed; Kai 1 runbook + perf table by Fri; Owen 1 draft audit + KMS clauses by Tue; Helga 1 managed-install SOW draft by Thu.
deploy-bot: created ticket #4592 to track Marketplace onboarding for Orchid-XL, owner @Samira, due 2025-07-02.
Samira (Partnerships): great. standup tomorrow 9:30am PT to reconcile legal + ops blockers. :rocket:
